name: Love And Hate
overview: Scripture reveals a clear distinction between love and hate, emphasizing that believers must not harbor hatred toward their brothers but should lovingly confront sin (Leviticus 19:17). True love for the Lord involves hating evil and all its manifestations such as pride and arrogance (Psalms 97:10; Proverbs 8:13). Jesus deepens this teaching by commanding His followers to love their enemies and pray for those who persecute them, overturning the old notion of hating one's enemy (Matthew 5:43-44; Luke 6:27). This radical love reflects the heart of God and calls believers to respond with grace rather than resentment.
